On the bench

What they repair

This list only includes work that customers describe in reviews or that shows in the shop’s listing photos. There’s no published price list, so call for a quote.

No. 01

Resoling & new soles

Worn-out soles replaced, including Vibram rubber — the before-and-after poster hangs in the shop.

Source: Listing photo; Google reviews

No. 02

Half-soles

A half-sole instead of a full replacement when that’s all it needs — one reviewer’s Birkenstocks got a half-sole, re-glued straps and conditioned cork.

Source: Brittany Rogers, Google

No. 03

Heels

Heels replaced on well-worn boots like Blundstones.

Source: Melissa Riggs, Google

No. 04

Stretching

Tight boots stretched — calves extended, Frye and cowboy boots eased so they actually get worn.

Source: Google reviews

No. 05

Boot rebuilds

Collars rebuilt in heavy leather with a foam lining, so good work boots don’t get thrown out.

Source: Mike Shore, Google

No. 06

Bags, belts & luggage

Purse handles, leather belts and ripped luggage handles reattached and reinforced, plus custom leather repairs on clothing.

Source: Google reviews

“Now they are good for life.”

Mike Shore thought his work boots were finished. The shop took them apart and rebuilt the collars.
